material.notes: AUDIT 41 (4): held at matched. Reproduced on the committed PNGs, light and dark (committed pictures re-rendered byte for byte): panel x 80 to 267 = 188 wide, rows 48, separators one row (192 and 304) with 8 above and 7 below = 16 rows, panel 80 to 415 = 336 high = 8 + 6 x 48 + 2 x 16 + 8, label to shortcut ink gap 13 px (ref menu-anchor-open@1x: Copy to Ctrl+C 14, light and dark), shortcut ink = label ink = on-surface (#1D1B20 light, #E6E0E9 dark; ref 1d1b20 for both), panel face f3edf7 / 211f26 against ref f2ecf4 / 211f24. Flutter source read: horizontal padding max(8, 12 + density) = 12 on Android, minimum 64 x 48, _MenuItemLabel adds 12 before the shortcut, vertical panel IntrinsicWidth. One correction: the 112 to 280 clamp the lane cites is the M3 spec, not in menu_anchor.dart (_MenuDefaultsM3 sets no minimum or maximum size); it does not bite in this sheet (188). Recorded deviations stand: the bar fills its container where Flutter's hugs, shade level 2 against 3, no MenuBar frame in the refs (hover and pressed bar cells unmeasured against Flutter). | ROUND 81 (u, flutter-compare-u.md): panel width fixed to its content as Flutter's IntrinsicWidth menu (menu_anchor.dart, _MenuItemLabel: 12 padding, label, 12, shortcut, 12 padding; held to the M3 menu's 112 to 280): the open-Cards panel is 188 wide (was 280, 105 px between label and shortcut, now 12), text ink starts 12 px in and the shortcut ink ends 12 px before the right edge, as in ref/flutter/material/light/menu-anchor-open@1x (last ink 12 px before the flat panel end, label ink 49 px in after a 24 px icon, rows 48 apart). Dividers 16 rows (8, line, 7) as Divider(height: 16), panel 336 high (8 + 6 x 48 + 2 x 16 + 8). The shortcut text is on-surface as in Flutter (was the muted tone). Held: whole-pixel bar (rows 38 to 85 = 48, x 20 to 499), titles 24 to 87, 88 to 151, 152 to 219, 220 to 283 (12 px padding, 64 minimum, Search 68), text 12 px in, hover e2dce6 and pressed ded8e2 (dark 312e36, 35323a) = 8 % and 10 % of on-surface, panel flush at y 80 under the bar ending at 79, rows 48, separators one row (cac4d0), disabled 38 %. Fails against menu_anchor.dart: the vertical panel is IntrinsicWidth (_MenuPanelState, _intrinsicCrossSize) with no minimum or maximum in _MenuDefaultsM3, and a row is padding 12, label, 12 (horizontalPadding in _MenuItemLabel), shortcut, padding 12. The widest row here, Increase Quantity (ink 110) and Num + (41), gives about 187 px; the picture is 280 (the M3 cap, not a source default), with 105 px between label and shortcut. The shortcut gap in navigation.e is 24 plus two 8 px flex gaps. Also: the dividers are 17 rows (panel 338 high; Flutter's Divider is 16), the shortcut is drawn muted where Flutter's Text inherits on-surface (M3 tokens say on-surface-variant: the two sources differ), and the tint on the open Cards title (10 %) has no line in menu_anchor.dart. Raise when the panel hugs its widest row (12 / 12 spacing) or the width is recorded as a deviation against Flutter. | ROUND 80 (s): standard density chosen and measured with the own comparer against Flutter menu_anchor.dart (_MenuBarDefaultsM3, _MenuButtonDefaultsM3 with _scaledPadding 12 at the standard density of Android, _MenuDefaultsM3). Bar 48 high on whole rows (32 to 79 in the open sheet), titles 12 px side padding and 64 x 48 minimum (File 64, Cards 64, Search 68, View 64 wide, text ink 12 px in), hover and pressed tones exact: light e2dce6 and ded8e2 over f3edf7, dark 312e36 and 35323a over 211f26 (on-surface 8 % and 10 %), keyboard focus the same as pressed. Menu panel hangs flush under its title (Flutter's menuPaddingOffset is zero, was 2 px), no slide-in (it left the panel on a fraction of a pixel), 280 wide, rows 48 and hovered row 201 to 248 on whole pixels, separators one row each (cac4d0, dark 49454f) at 192 and 305, panel f3edf7 equal to the bar. Hover and pressed cells now target the View title so the bar keeps its 480 width in all four cells. Light and dark viewed. flutter-compare-s.md.
